info.title: Cartesia Turn-Detecting Speech-to-Text WebSocket API
info.description:
Realtime speech transcription with built-in turn detection

<Note>
`ink-2` and `ink-preview` support English, French, Hindi, Japanese, and Spanish,
and detect the language automatically.
</Note>

model.description:
ID of the model to use for transcription: `ink-2`, `ink-preview`.

See [Models](/build-with-cartesia/stt/latest) for details.

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the audio in Hz.

turn_start_threshold.description:
Threshold above which to start the turn. Default: 0.8. Range: 0.5–0.9. Must stay above the eager end threshold.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

turn_eager_end_threshold.description:
Threshold below which to eager end the turn. Default: 0.6. Range: 0.3–0.8. Must stay between the end and start thresholds.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

turn_end_threshold.description:
Threshold below which to end the turn. Default: 0.3. Range: 0.05–0.5. Must stay below the eager end threshold.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

turn_end_timeout_ms.description:
Maximum amount of time in milliseconds that the model will wait after the user stops speaking before ending the turn. Default: 5600. Range: 640–11200.

See [Configuring turn detection](/use-the-api/stt/turns#configuring-turn-detection) for details.

keyterm.description:
Key terms to improve the recall of specific words and phrases.

Repeat the `keyterm` query parameter to pass multiple values, up to 100 keyterms totaling 1200 characters. To boost one multi-word phrase, join the words with `%20`.

Example: `?keyterm=Ink%202&keyterm=Cartesia`

See [Keyterm prompting](/use-the-api/stt/keyterms) for details.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key for trusted server applications.

accessToken.name: access_token
accessToken.description: Short-lived token for browser and mobile applications.

STTTurnsAudioData.name: STTTurnsAudioData
STTTurnsAudioData.title: Send Audio Data
STTTurnsAudioData.description:
Send WebSocket binary messages containing raw audio data as specified by the `encoding` and `sample_rate` query parameters.

Audio Requirements:
- Send audio in small chunks, e.g. 100 ms
- Audio format must match the `encoding` and `sample_rate` parameters

STTTurnsCloseCommand.name: STTTurnsCloseCommand
STTTurnsCloseCommand.title: Close Command
STTTurnsCloseCommand.description: Send a JSON encoded close command as WebSocket text message to close the session cleanly. All buffered audio will be processed by the model into events.

STTTurnsConfigCommand.name: STTTurnsConfigCommand
STTTurnsConfigCommand.title: Config Command
STTTurnsConfigCommand.description: Send a JSON encoded config command as a WebSocket text message to update model settings.

STTTurnsConnected.name: STTTurnsConnected
STTTurnsConnected.title: Connected
STTTurnsConnected.description:
Fires once when the WebSocket connection is established.

You do not need to wait for this event before sending audio.

STTTurnsTurnStart.name: STTTurnsTurnStart
STTTurnsTurnStart.title: Turn Start
STTTurnsTurnStart.description:
Marks the start of a user turn. Fires quickly after the user begins speaking.

This event can be used to interrupt your agent to avoid talking over the user.

STTTurnsTurnUpdate.name: STTTurnsTurnUpdate
STTTurnsTurnUpdate.title: Turn Update
STTTurnsTurnUpdate.description: Fires repeatedly as the model transcribes the current user turn.

STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd.name: STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd
STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd.title: Turn Eager End
STTTurnsTurnEagerEnd.description: Fires when the model predicts that the user might be done speaking.

STTTurnsTurnResume.name: STTTurnsTurnResume
STTTurnsTurnResume.title: Turn Resume
STTTurnsTurnResume.description: Fires after `turn.eager_end` if the user turn has not actually ended.

STTTurnsTurnEnd.name: STTTurnsTurnEnd
STTTurnsTurnEnd.title: Turn End
STTTurnsTurnEnd.description: Marks the end of a user turn.

STTErrorResponse.name: STTErrorResponse
STTErrorResponse.title: Error Response
STTErrorResponse.description: Error information for STT WebSocket connections.

SpeechToTextTurnsEncoding.description:
The encoding format of the audio data. This determines how the server interprets the raw binary audio data you send.

For guidance on choosing an encoding, see [Audio Input](/build-with-cartesia/stt/audio-input).
